features.title: New thread destination and workspace isolation
features.summary: Above a new thread's composer: pick the folder (or none), the jj bookmark it starts from, and whether it gets its own jj workspace beside the repository.
reach: fill textbox "Search projects or enter a folder path" "sample"

configuration.constraints: Initial workspace toggle for new threads in a jj repository.
Existing local bookmark new threads start from.
Removes a thread workspace only when every thread in it is archived and it has no unlanded work.

failureModes: A folder outside a jj repository offers no bookmark or isolation.
A thread workspace with unlanded work is never removed by the sweep.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv jj CLI through the DSH subprocess service with a timeout; the only shell is the operator-configured setup command.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary jj repositories in src/threads.integration.test.ts; no jj mock is used.

verification.reason: The destination bar needs a running Host with a jj project; covered by real-jj host tests until a Playwright journey composes it.

verification.testName: provisions a checked-out workspace on the bookmark and recognises it as a thread
lists local bookmarks and starts a thread from the chosen one
discards an empty thread completely and refuses one with unlanded work

features.title: Land a thread onto the bookmark
features.summary: Rebase a thread's described work onto the landing bookmark and move the bookmark forward; conflicts and undescribed revisions are handed back to the thread's agent.

configuration.constraints: Queues a message to the thread's latest unarchived Session when Land stops.

failureModes: A conflict leaves the bookmark where it was.
Placeholder descriptions (empty or wip) are refused.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv jj CLI through the DSH subprocess service with a timeout; the only shell is the operator-configured setup command.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary jj repositories in src/threads.integration.test.ts; no jj mock is used.

verification.reason: The Land button needs a running Host with a jj project; covered by real-jj host tests until a Playwright journey composes it.

verification.testName: lands described work onto the bookmark and leaves a fresh working copy
asks for a description instead of landing placeholder work
reports conflicting files and keeps the bookmark where it was
